start.text:
[TODO:ko] Thousands have climbed the hill.
They hunger for his every word.

send_away.text:
[TODO:ko] His eyes hold the whole crowd.
None will leave empty.

rest_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Mercy First
rest_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Their hunger is his concern.
Stand ready beside him.

compassion.title: [TODO:ko] Evening Falls
compassion.text:
[TODO:ko] "They have nothing to eat."
The disciples murmur in fear.

count_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not by Silver
count_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Two hundred coins would not be enough.
Look with new eyes.

boy.title: [TODO:ko] A Small Offering
boy.text:
[TODO:ko] A boy lifts a humble basket.
Five loaves. Two small fish.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Faith places it in his hands.

dismiss_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Little Is Much
dismiss_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] In his hands, little is plenty.
Receive the boy's gift.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Honor the Gift
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] His brave little heart deserves more.
Carry his basket gently.

bless.title: [TODO:ko] He Lifts His Eyes
bless.text:
[TODO:ko] He raises the bread to heaven.
A hush falls on the hillside.

unbelief_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Stay and See
unbelief_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] The miracle begins in his hands.
Do not miss it.

distribute.text:
[TODO:ko] He breaks. He gives. He breaks again.
The baskets do not empty.

waste_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Every fragment is mercy made bread.
Let nothing be lost.
